subject: Inner Garden Window
text: Aiming and firing the Fairy Slingshot right at the castle window makes a Red Rupee worth twenty pop out.

evidence.quote: Equip the Fairy Slingshot and aim right at the window, when you fire it a Red Rupee will pop out, that's worth twenty!

subject: Princess Zelda
text: Approaching and speaking with Princess Zelda gives Link Zelda's Letter.

evidence.quote: When you're ready then approach Princess Zelda and speak with her.  After a long speech she gives you a letter, ZELDA'S LETTER.

subject: Impa
text: Speaking with Impa at the exit of Hyrule Castle teaches Link the first song for the Fairy Ocarina.

evidence.quote: Leave Zelda and speak with the person at the exit, Impa.  She will teach you our first song for the Fairy Ocarina.

subject: Super Cucco minigame
text: Finding all three Super Cuccos in thirty seconds for ten Rupees earns Lon Lon Milk in an Empty Bottle from Talon.

evidence.quote: Speak with Talon and for ten Rupees you can challenge yourself to try to find all three Super Cuccos in thirty seconds....After you have located all three of the Super Cuccos, Talon will reward your with some LON LON MILK.  It's not actually the milk that is worth it but rather the EMPTY BOTTLE that you have after the milk is gone.

subject: Tree Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the only tree in the horse area reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields token 006.

evidence.quote: run up to the tree and roll into it to hear the secret sound and reveal a Gold Skulltula.  Defeat this enemy to acquire yet another GOLD SKULLTULA [006].

subject: Stone Tower Crawlspace
text: Moving the upper-right box and upper-left box inside the stone tower accesses a crawlspace leading to Piece of Heart 002.

evidence.quote: The upper right most box, the one beside the cow should be pulled down toward the door.  After one pull go to the other side and push it down.  Now grab hold of the box in the upper left corner, the corner you want to access and pull it to the right.  You should now be able to get to the crawlspace.  Press the A button to get into the crawlspace and at the end you will find a PIECE OF HEART [002].

subject: Malon
text: Using the Fairy Ocarina to play along with Malon in the middle of Lon Lon Ranch teaches Epona's Song.

evidence.quote: Use your Ocarina and she should teach you the notes to the song, play along with it and you will learn EPONA'S SONG.

subject: Cow
text: Playing Epona's Song beside a cow with an Empty Bottle yields free Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Take an Empty Bottle and head over to a cow.  Stand beside it and whip out the Fairy Ocarina.  Play Epona's Song, up, left, right, up left, right and the cow will give you free Lon Lon Milk, as will other cows.

subject: Feeding Area Gold Skulltula
text: Visiting the feeding area behind the inner horse fence at night reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields token 007.

evidence.quote: Re-enter Lon Lon Ranch at night.  Make your way all the way around to the south side of the ranch, note on your map that there is kind of a little feeding area just along the edge of the horse fence, not the outer wall of the ranch, the inner fence.  What you want to do is go around behind this little area and there you will find another GOLD SKULLTULA [007], be sure to defeat it and add another token to the collection.

subject: Tree Target
text: Shooting the exact centre of the target circle three times in a row with the Fairy Slingshot awards a Bullet Bag upgrading seed capacity from 40 to 50.

evidence.quote: Whip out your trust Fairy Slingshot and fire a seed at the exact centre of the circle, you'll know you hit the centre if the number 100 pops up.  Hit it exactly three times in a row and something good will happen, a Deku Scrub will come out and give you another BULLET BAG, this time upgrading the amount of seeds you can carry from 40 to 50.

subject: Wolf
text: Target the wolf with L/Z, deflect its attacks with the R shield button, and perform a jumping slash with the A button right after it attacks.

evidence.quote: Target the wolf with the L/Z button and then while targeting hold your shield with the R button to deflect attacks.  Now when you think you have a clear shot, for example right after he attacks, press the A button to do the jumping slash which is quite powerful.

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: Dropping down the hole between ladders in Sacred Forest Meadow leads to a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: There is a hole down at the bottom of this area, when you drop down the hole you'll find a Fairy Fountain.

subject: Saria
text: Ascending the large staircase to reach Saria results in learning Saria's Song.

evidence.quote: Return to that large staircase and ascend it to reach the top where you will find Saria.  She will teach you SARIA'S SONG which will

subject: Ocarina Minigame
text: Memorizing and playing back songs of five, six, and eight notes on the tree stump earns a Green Rupee, a Blue Rupee, and Piece of Heart 003.

evidence.quote: They will gradually move up to a song with five notes to it, simply listen and look at what they play and then play it yourself.  The prize for winning this is a GREEN RUPEE.  Agree to play again and this time you will have to follow along up to six notes instead of five.  Your reward for completing this challenge will be a BLUE RUPEE.  Finally there is one more that involves you playing and memorizing eight notes.  It shouldn't be too difficult and your reward for this far exceeds the previous two, you get a PIECE OF HEART [003] for completing it successfully.

subject: Skull Kid Tree Stump
text: Playing Saria's Song while standing on the tree stump rewards Link with Piece of Heart 004.

evidence.quote: Jump onto the tree stump and press the C button associated with your Fairy Ocarina.  Play Saria's Song while standing on this stump and the kid will give you yet another PIECE OF HEART [004].

subject: Deku Scrub Merchant
text: Deflecting a Deku Nut back at the scrub behind the pillars allows purchasing the Deku Stick Upgrade for 40 Rupees to carry 20 Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote: There you will find a Deku Scrub hidden behind one of the pillars.  Use your shield and deflect a Deku Nut back at him.  After doing so approach the Deku Scrub and speak to him.  You can purchase the DEKU STICK UPGRADE from this little scrub, for the low low price of 40 Rupees he will enable you to be able to carry around 20 Deku Sticks, it's well worth the price.

subject: House Side Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing the stairs to the right past the central tree at night reveals a Skulltula on the side of a house that yields token 008.

evidence.quote: When you have the first opportunity to make a right, do so and climb up the stairs.  Make a right at the top of the stairs and you will come across a Skulltula crawling on the side of the house, eliminate this enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [008].

subject: Brick Wall Gold Skulltula
text: Climbing past the central tree up to the brick area reveals a Skulltula crawling on the brick wall that yields token 009.

evidence.quote: climb the stairs straight ahead of you and turn around to find another set of stairs going even higher, up to that kind of brick area.  Here you will find another Skulltula crawling around on the brick wall, eliminate it and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA [009].

subject: Lookout Tower Ladder Gold Skulltula
text: Firing two Deku Seeds at the Skulltula crawling on the tall tower ladder allows climbing up to acquire token 010.

evidence.quote: When you get up there move to the north side of that tall tower, then pull out your Fairy Slingshot and aim up at it.  Crawling around on the ladder is yet another Skulltula, fire two Deku Seeds at this enemy and then climb up the ladder to acquire the GOLD SKULLTULA [010].

subject: Dampe Gravedigging Tour
text: Paying Dampe 10 Rupees to dig on the dirt patches along the stone path can yield Piece of Heart 005.

evidence.quote: The old man Dampe should be wandering around the graveyard here, when you speak to him he offers to dig up a portion of the ground for the low low price of 10 Rupees.  The only purpose of doing this is to hope you acquire the PIECE OF HEART [005]...What you're trying to do is speak to him and have him dig while he's on the patches of dirt on the stone path, not the stone path itself, if you look you'll see them.

subject: Royal Family Tombstone
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem destroys the large tombstone and reveals the entrance to the Royal Tomb.

evidence.quote: Now what you want to do is head over to the east side of the graveyard beside the large tombstone and stand on the Triforce emblem on the ground.  Use your Fairy Ocarina and play Zelda's Lullaby, which is left, up, right, left, up, right.  After doing this there is a large explosion and the tombstone is destroyed, revealing a path down into the ground.

subject: Royal Tomb First Room Door
text: Eliminating the four bats perched on the walls with the Fairy Slingshot unlocks the door in the Royal Tomb.

evidence.quote: What you will want to do is equip the Fairy Slingshot and use it to eliminate the four bats you see perched on the walls here.  After doing that the door will be unlocked and you can climb up the ledge and continue through it.

subject: Royal Tomb Wall Inscription
text: Playing the melody written on the wall inscription at the end of the Royal Tomb teaches the Sun's Song.

evidence.quote: When you reach the end of the tomb take a look at the inscription on the wall.  You will notice that below it there is some kind of melody already written on there, perhaps you should play it.  After doing so you learn the SUN'S SONG.
